title: クレーンゲーム大成功！

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A veritable mountain of plushies, all for me. Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I feel not only happy, but also strangely at peace. I can't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm getting this soft, warm feeling—and not just from the plushies themselves.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's because… this gift came from the heart.
